purpose: Expose the additive components behind the regional satisfaction proxy so a reviewer can trace the score to time, waiting, crowding, curb conflict, accessibility, reliability and people-flow conflict.
formula: score = clamp(100 - time - wait - crowding - curb - accessibility - reliability - conflict, 0, 100)
component_units: proxy points per synthetic agent; not money, minutes or survey responses
calibration_required_before_local_decisi: grouped resident, employee, care-trip and night-worker intercept or survey responses
dated 15-minute OD, departure, boarding and denied-boarding observations
curb conflict logs and continuous accessibility walk-throughs
resident and employee review of the component interpretation
source_boundaries: MATSIM-LARGE-SCALE-ABM and MATSIM-BOOK-ACTIVITY-BASED are method references only; no external coefficients are transferred.
TRANSPORT-EQUITY-DISTRIBUTION-2023 supports grouped-distribution review; it does not provide Haidian outcomes.
The component weights are declared package inputs and remain synthetic until local calibration evidence is authorized.
interpretation: The screen makes a synthetic aggregate utility proxy readable. It does not establish resident satisfaction, employee preference, public acceptance, local operating performance or field service quality.
